1946. Employee Salary Calculator Using Methods

40

Medium

Problem Statement

Write a program that uses methods to calculate various salary components of an employee.

Description

Create separate methods to perform the following tasks:

Calculate HRA (20% of Basic Salary).
Calculate DA (10% of Basic Salary).
Calculate Gross Salary.
Display all calculated values.

Read the employee's basic salary and invoke the methods to generate the output.
